subject: kCFRunLoopDefaultMode

observation.summary: CoreFoundation ships no standalone Mach-O on macOS 27 (/System/Library/Frameworks/CoreFoundation.framework/CoreFoundation is a broken symlink); its image is resident in the arm64e dyld shared cache (sha256 ecc822c56dbce82d0f151afd7bf8492e91b109944483614f0eaaf377ac7d21da), so otool-exports and nm-symbols both return status=tool-failed against this path. dyld_info resolves the canonical path through the cache and reads the image's LC_DYLD_EXPORTS_TRIE directly. source_artifact is the verbatim dyld_info export dump captured to the cache directory, which is the observed artifact. _kCFRunLoopDefaultMode appears in the export trie as a exported data symbol inside __DATA_CONST (__DATA_CONST spans 0x1E020DB38-0x1E05BF938), i.e. a read-only global pointer.

claim: kCFRunLoopDefaultMode is exported by CoreFoundation on macOS 27 as a __DATA_CONST global pointer, not as a function, which is consistent with its CFStringRef-typed definition in CFRunLoop.h.
